ACME APPLIANCES LTD.
Confidential OEM specification - not for retail packaging

Product: Acme Rapid Kettle
Model identifier: ARK-1500
SKU: ARK-1500-EU-B
Manufacturer: Acme Appliances Ltd.
Factory: Shenzhen assembly line 3

Electrical ratings (nameplate): 230 V, 50 Hz, class I
Supply cord: 0.75 mm2, 0.75 m, Schuko plug
Net weight: 0.92 kg
Master carton: 6 units, 420 x 280 x 260 mm

This document describes the OEM kettle supplied to private-label buyers.
Market-facing contact details are supplied by the buyer, not by the factory.

2. Physical construction

The vessel is a stainless steel body with a polypropylene handle and lid.
A removable mesh filter sits in the spout. Colour: brushed steel / black handle.

Fill between the min mark and the max mark. The usable capacity is 1.5 L
when filled to the max line. Do not fill above the max mark.

Intended use: Boiling water for domestic use. Not for commercial catering
or outdoor cooking.

The heating element is concealed in the base of the jug. Do not operate
the kettle on an induction hob. Keep the rating label on the base visible.

3. Packing, care, and end of life

Goods in the carton: kettle body, 360-degree power base, unbranded leaflet.

Automatic shut-off: a steam sensor switches the kettle off at boil.
Boil-dry protection cuts power if the vessel is empty.

Cleaning: descale with a 1:1 white vinegar solution. Do not immerse the
power base. Do not use abrasive pads on the heating plate.

End of life: this product must not be disposed of with household waste;
take it to a WEEE collection point.

Factory warranty: 12 months against manufacturing defects. Retail warranty
is the buyer's responsibility. Batch coding: YYWW plus line id on the base.

User instructions

Acme Rapid Kettle
Model ARK-1500
Manufacturer: Acme Appliances Ltd.

Please read these instructions before first use and keep them for later
reference. Retain the carton until you have checked that nothing is missing.

Technical data
Rated voltage: 230 V
Rated frequency: 50 Hz
Protection class: I

Place the kettle on a stable, heat-resistant surface away from the edge
of the worktop. Do not use it outdoors.

About this kettle

This cordless kettle is for household hot-water preparation. Place it on
a dry surface and keep the cord clear of the hob.

The jug holds 1.7 L to the maximum mark. A water window on the handle
shows the level. The lid opens with the button on the handle.

If the kettle was transported on its side, let it stand upright for
30 minutes before connecting the base.

Keep children away from the steam when the kettle switches off.

Before first use, fill to max, boil, and discard the water twice.

To boil
1. Sit the 360-degree power base on a level surface and plug it in.
2. Fill the kettle, close the lid, and place it on the base.
3. Press the switch down. The indicator lamp lights.
4. The kettle switches off automatically when the water boils. Lift the jug to pour.

The kettle includes: kettle, power base, and spout filter.

If you lift the kettle off the base, it switches off. Replace it and
press the switch again to restart.

Safety and care

A boil-dry cut-out operates if the kettle is switched on with little or
no water. Allow it to cool, refill, then restart.

Descaling: use a kettle descaler or equal parts water and white vinegar.
Rinse thoroughly. Do not put the kettle or the base in a dishwasher.
Do not immerse the base in water.

When the product is worn out, do not put it in household rubbish.
Deliver it to a local electrical-waste (WEEE) collection site.

Keep the kettle out of reach of children. Do not open the lid while boiling.
